offerings.heading: Floors first, then <mark>everything off the floor.</mark>
items: Garage floor coatings in high-grade, durable materials
Personalized solutions depending on functionality and style
Concierge level of service from the whole team

story.heading: Why the reviews say the same thing
paragraphs: Philadelphia Garage built its reputation on two decisions repeated for more than 20 years: hire the best installers and use quality materials.
The concierge level of service is the other half. One team plans the floor and the storage together, then installs without upending your week.

experience.heading: How a makeover runs
items: A visit to the garage with real measurements and real samples.
Floor and storage designed for each other.
Installation by the same crew, then a walk-through.

feature.heading: Beautiful, durable garage floors
feature.text: High-grade coatings resist hot tires, road salt, and dropped tools, and they wipe clean. The finish is chosen with you.

closing.heading: Award-winning garage floors and organization
closing.kicker: West Chester, serving the Philadelphia area
